activities.title: FreshStart Hub - Orientation Event Finder guided Build

contract.doing: Build freshstart-hub from the supplied tree, six fictional event records, semantic shell, CSS sections, application-state signature, safe storage helper contract, test matrix, README outline, and ignore file. The exact event shape is id, title, dateLabel, location, category, and summary, all non-empty strings; category is academic, community, or wellbeing. Fetch ./data/events.json, validate all records, and expose loading, success, no-match, empty, HTTP/data error, and Retry states. A labelled search form, category select, Saved only checkbox, Clear filters button, and generated Save buttons update one state object and one render boundary. Search trims and ignores case across title, location, and summary; category and saved filters combine. Save buttons use stable data-id and aria-pressed, and only the saved string-ID array persists under freshstart.savedIds.v1. Missing storage starts empty; malformed or non-array storage is preserved, blocks saves, and requires Reset saved data. Keep relative paths, responsive 320/768/1280 and 200-percent behavior, visible focus, status announcements, and safe generated text. Publish the sanitized source through GitHub Pages, deliberately expose and repair the supplied case-sensitive Events.json path, and verify every live asset. Exclude backend submission, authentication, account data, packages, framework, build step, API key, external API, service worker, date parsing, remote writes, and production claims.
contract.why: FreshStart Hub turns seven isolated proofs into one application another person can open, understand, operate, debug, and verify at a real HTTPS URL. Its fixed scope demonstrates integration without disguising untaught backend, framework, authentication, or build-tool work as beginner independence.
contract.output: A public FreshStart Hub repository and deployed HTTPS site with six validated events, accessible combined filters, durable and recoverable saved IDs, honest request states, complete local/live acceptance evidence, safe commit history, a repaired Pages path, and signed human review.
